iconicAnchor.label: Grafana monitoring dashboard
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Grafana defines a dashboard as related query-driven panels organized for at-a-glance understanding, monitoring, and troubleshooting across one or more operational data sources.

sources.title: Dashboards
supports: Operational dashboards organize related visualizations into panels, rows, or tabs for at-a-glance monitoring and troubleshooting.
Queries, transformations, controls, and panel options connect the visual system to real data and decisions.

sources.title: Introduction to dashboard tiles for Power BI designers
supports: A dashboard combines multiple data tiles and can include reports, streaming data, text, images, video, and web content.
Tiles support an overview surface that can lead into deeper reports rather than acting as unrelated decorative charts.
